text.tspan: Most common items of waste in the ocean by region
Each item's share of total litter in nearshore waters, which are within 100 kilometers of the coast.
Note: Data comes from global samples of more than 12 million litter items in major aquatic environments. This is shown for the 10 most
common items in each region, based on the counts/number of items found.
